messages:
jen-ops: :rotating_light: Paging — embeddings async fanout spiked at 10:12 UTC. Error 429s and elevated edge CPU. Latency elevated, some customers reporting degraded responses. Telemetry: ~120k req/min (baseline ~8k).

incident-bot: alert triggered: embeddings-edge-fanout-high (severity: high). Paging oncall.

sam-sre: oncall here. Can we get fingerprinting info? any obvious api keys or client ids?

jen-ops: early signals point to one client id dominating (~70%): custX-alpha. Calls look like tight-loop single-token embeddings. I'm going to push a temporary per-key quota and enable quota-slicing for the embeddings route.

mike-eng: agree. I'll push a targeted rate-slice rule at the edge: ```rule { match: path:/v1/embeddings async, key: api_key, limit: 5r/s, burst: 50 }``` deploying now.

jen-ops: applied dynamic quota via infra admin API: `POST /admin/quota` body `{ "key":"custX-alpha", "limit":300000 }` — effect should be immediate. Also toggling off public `embeddings-batch` for 10m: `toggle embeddings-batch off`.

security-bot: WAF logs show same UA + ASN pattern -> ASN 64512, likely proxy cluster. Recommending tarpit + captcha challenge on login/ingest where fingerprint matches. Prepared WAF rule id=5582.

sam-sre: enable tarpit for ASN 64512 and drop heavy fanout agents. Also add a short circuit-breaker: fail-fast for embeddings jobs that exceed 3s prep time to free up workers.

jen-ops: tarpit engaged for ASN 64512 :lock: WAF rule 5582 applied at edge. Circuit-breaker set to 200 concurrent embeddings. Dynamic quota in place for custX-alpha.

katy-cs: thanks. Which customers see impact? I'll prepare a status page blurb and DM the top affected accounts. We should include guidance for SDK customers to retry/backoff.

jen-ops: top affected: custX-alpha (throttled), partner-b (partial), internal-test. Draft status note: "We have applied targeted throttles and WAF mitigations to stem abusive traffic impacting embeddings. Some customers may experience increased throttling or 429s. We are monitoring and will update within 15 minutes."

mike-eng: monitoring telemetry — EU edges recovering to baseline, US edges still warm. Rolling a KV-prefix cache to collapse duplicate requests and cut compute.

sam-sre: good. Reassess in 10m; if traffic doesn't drop we'll escalate to legal for takedown coordination and consider broader IP blocks.

jen-ops: noted for handoff. oncall plan: @mike-eng covers until 11:30 UTC, then @sam-sre. Will update when we roll back toggles.

katy-cs: ETA for status post? I'll publish within 5 mins and include contact route for urgent impacted customers. :eyes:

mike-eng: confirmed — telemetry looks stable, keeping rule active for now.

sam-sre: thanks all — adding postmortem stub and action items: (1) add automated detection for single-key fanout, (2) improve per-key burst controls, (3) run tabletop for coordinated WAF+quota response.

jen-ops: closing thread for now. Continue monitoring in #incidents and handoff to next oncall. :shipit:
